topic: Data aggregation and sensor recalibration requests
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered several data processing issues. First, a query was raised regarding impression counts for specific locations (Gabon and Ivory), noting that impressions were being counted for half of the model locations even when date/time parameters were not provided. Additionally, previously included sensor location impressions are now showing as zero during aggregation.

Regarding technical scripts, one participant advised ignoring a comment in an aggregation script related to filtering by a single dataset.

Finally, a request was made to change the calibration for three specific sensors (Bite_LV_Riga Plaza, Bite_LV_Origo 4, and Bite_LV_Alfa) back to a previous setting (78) and recalculate historical data. This task was advised to be postponed until the next morning due to its computational load on the servers.
decisions: The aggregation script comment regarding filtering by one dataset should be ignored.
action_items: Postpone sensor recalibration and historical data recalculation for three specific sensors until the following morning.
